# Office relocation

**To:** All staff
**From:** Operations
**Date:** 2 November 2026

The lease on our current office ends on 31 March next year, and after reviewing four buildings over the summer we have signed for the third floor of 120 Harbour Street. This memo explains what changes, when it happens, and what each team needs to do before the move.

## Why we are moving

The current office was planned for forty people. We are now sixty-two, and most days every meeting room is booked from nine until five. The new floor is larger by about a third, has eight meeting rooms instead of four, and sits two minutes from the station rather than fifteen. The rent per square metre is slightly lower, because the building is older and the landlord is refitting it at their own cost.

We also looked at staying and taking the empty unit next door. That would have kept everyone in a familiar place, but the two units cannot be joined without closing the building for a month, and the landlord would only offer a three-year term. The Harbour Street lease runs for seven years with a break after five.

## Timeline

The fit-out starts on 5 January and is due to finish on 27 February. We will have the keys for the first two weeks of March to install the network, test the phones and move the archive boxes. Teams move over the weekend of 14 and 15 March, one floor plan zone at a time, and the old office closes for good on Friday 20 March.

If the fit-out runs late, the move moves with it. The current landlord has agreed in writing to a month's extension at the same rent, so there is no risk of a gap between the two buildings.

## What each team needs to do

Every team lead will receive a floor plan and a packing list in the first week of February. Before then, please go through your shared cupboards and decide what is worth taking. Anything left in the old office after 20 March will be cleared by the landlord's contractors and cannot be recovered.

Personal items should go home before the move weekend. Crates will be delivered to each desk on Monday 9 March and collected on Friday 13 March. Label every crate with your name and new desk number, which will be on the floor plan.

Laptops, monitors and docking stations will be moved by the IT team. Please do not pack them yourself. Leave them on your desk with the cables attached, and they will be waiting on your new desk on Monday morning.

## Getting there

The new office is at 120 Harbour Street, third floor. The nearest station is Harbour Street on the central line, and the entrance is opposite the north exit. There are twelve bicycle spaces in the basement and showers on the ground floor. There is no car park, but the public car park on Mill Lane offers a monthly rate to tenants of the building.

## Questions

Operations will hold two open sessions in the large meeting room, on 12 January and 9 February, at four in the afternoon. You can also write to the operations mailbox at any time. We will keep a list of questions and answers on the intranet and update it every week until the move.
